claim: The sample demo saves nothing to the real request inbox.
where: landing action, demo banner, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh browser context; compare owner inbox count before and after a complete demo submission; assert only demo API routes are called

claim: Prices require an owner-created opaque client link that can expire or be revoked.
where: landing facts, how it works, owner workspace, README
sandbox: fresh server data; assert root and predictable legacy token reveal no price; create a 40-character link, read its catalog, revoke it, then assert 410

claim: A valid client request appears in the owner inbox.
sandbox: create an opaque client link, submit through the browser, then query the authenticated owner inbox

claim: Owners can export requests as CSV and PDF.
sandbox: fresh server with sample request; assert CSV header and PDF signature from authenticated export routes

claim: The landing and demo flows load no analytics, remote fonts, or tracking scripts.
sandbox: record every browser request across landing and demo; assert the only origin is the product origin

claim: Sending a request does not charge the client, reserve stock, or create a purchase.
sandbox: submit a sample request while recording requests; assert same-origin request completion and the explicit terms

claim: Owners choose exactly which offers each private client link can open.
sandbox: create two private links, assign a different offer to each, and assert each catalog exposes only its assigned offer

claim: Owners can export or delete one request without exposing other clients’ details.
sandbox: create two requests, export one CSV, delete that one, and assert the other remains while the deleted CSV returns 404
